name: Electra Consumer Products (1970) Ltd
summary: Electra Consumer Products (1970) Ltd manufactures, imports, exports, sells, distributes, markets, and provides services to a range of consumer electric products in Israel. The company offers home and commercial air-conditioning solutions, such as air conditioners, mini central air conditioners, inverter systems, VRF systems, multi-split systems, water-based units, and computerized control and management systems, as well as related services. In addition, it operates a chain network of 45 branches that sell electrical and electronic appliances under the Shekem Electric name; and 41 branches of electrical warehouses under the Machsanei Hachashmal name. Electra Consumer Products (1970) Ltd was founded in 1945 and is based in Rishon LeZion, Israel.
